events.place: Quai du Mont-Blanc, Geneva
events.desc: Geneva's big Christmas market on the lakefront: wooden chalets, street food, a fondue chalet, a Christmas pub and a carousel. Opens 19 Nov from 17:00.

events.title: Montreux Noël — Christmas market on the lake
events.place: Quai de Montreux, Montreux
events.desc: One of Switzerland's best-known Christmas markets, with over 150 chalets along the lakefront, a flying Santa and extra stalls up at Château de Chillon and Roche

events.title: Uetliberger Weihnachtsmarkt — Christmas market on Zurich's mountain
events.place: Uto Kulm, Uetliberg, Zürich
events.desc: Weekend-only Christmas market at the top of the Uetliberg, with craft stalls, mulled wine and views over the city; easy to combine with a short walk.

events.title: Polarzauber — Christmas market in Zürich HB
events.place: Zürich Hauptbahnhof, Bahnhofplatz, Zürich
events.desc: One of Europe's biggest indoor Christmas markets fills the main station hall around a giant decorated tree, with gift stalls, food and bars.

events.title: Bellevue Noël — Christmas village on Sechseläutenplatz
events.place: Sechseläutenplatz, Zürich
events.desc: The new name for the old Wienachtsdorf: a Christmas village in front of the Opera House with craft chalets, food, a fondue chalet and a bar open late.

events.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Münsterhof
events.place: Münsterhof, by the Fraumünster, Zürich
events.desc: A smaller, pretty Christmas market on the square by the Fraumünster church, with gifts, crafts and mulled wine.

events.title: Singing Christmas Tree & market, Werdmühleplatz
events.place: Werdmühleplatz, Zürich
events.desc: Choirs sing from a giant tree-shaped stage several times a day, surrounded by a small market and a fondue chalet.

events.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Dörfli in the Niederdorf
events.place: Niederdorfstrasse, Zürich
events.desc: Christmas stalls along the cobbled old-town lanes of the Niederdorf, good for small gifts and a stroll.

events.title: Zürcher Weihnachtsallee at Europaallee
events.place: Europaallee, Zürich
events.desc: A Christmas avenue next to the main station with chalets, a Glühstube and a fondue chalet; opens 19 Nov at 16:00.
